title: lithospermum leonotis
intro: Lithospermum leonotis, commonly known as Gromwell, is a perennial plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae) native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, aiding in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gromwell are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Lithospermum leonotis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
